audience: engineers who triage production errors, deploys and error history in Rollbar

useCases.title: Find the most active errors
useCases.text: List the most active error items of the last hours, with their occurrence counts. Open one item to read its title, status and level.

useCases.title: Read the stack traces of an error
useCases.text: Find an item by its project counter or an occurrence UUID. List its occurrences, newest first, to read the stack traces and request data.

useCases.title: Link an error to a recent deploy
useCases.text: List the recent deploys and open one to read its environment, revision and time. Count occurrences over time to see when an error began.

useCases.title: Mark an error resolved in a version
useCases.text: Set an item to resolved and name the version that fixed it. The change shows to the whole team, so confirm it first.

useCases.title: Review the history of an item
useCases.text: List the history of an item: comments, status, level and assignee changes. List the teams of the account for context.
